name: graspt
displayName: Graspt — Allocentric Proof Navigation for Lean
description: Navigate Lean 4 proofs as a topological map of landmarks: what humanity already knows, and what can be reached by combining it. Glues the Lean 4 extension, Mathlib and AI coding agents (pi, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode).

commands.title: Graspt: Open Proof Map in New Window (map + chat mode)
Graspt: Set Meta AI (Muse) API Key for pi
Graspt: Doctor (check Lean, Mathlib, Meta Muse + pi)

graspt.toolsProject.description: Path to the Lake project that contains the Graspt Lean tooling (graspt-trace / graspt-atlas). Defaults to `<workspace>/lean`.

graspt.atlasDir.description: Directory containing atlas.json / importance.json. Defaults to `<toolsProject>/.graspt/atlas`.

graspt.agent.preset.description: Which coding agent proposes proof branches. Defaults to `pi` (pi.dev) running Meta's Muse model (`meta/muse-spark-1.3` or `meta/muse-wonder-1.0`).

graspt.metaAi.apiKey.description: Meta AI API key (`META_API_KEY`) for Muse models in `pi`. Prefer setting via `Graspt: Set Meta AI (Muse) API Key for pi`.

graspt.metaAi.model.description: Meta Muse model ID used inside the `pi` coding agent (`--model meta/<model>`).

graspt.agent.command.description: Custom agent command (used when preset = custom). `{prompt}` is replaced with the prompt, e.g. ["pi", "-p", "--no-session", "{prompt}"].

graspt.agent.timeoutSec.description: Timeout for a single agent call.

graspt.lookahead.parallelism.description: Number of parallel Lean verifier processes used to check candidate branches (each holds its own environment in RAM).

graspt.lookahead.useWorktrees.description: Materialise each candidate branch in a git worktree under .graspt/worktrees (with .lake symlinked) so agents and humans can inspect it.

graspt.level.description: Default proof resolution: 1 = micro (every step), 2 = meso, 3 = macro (only structural pivots and landmarks).

graspt.landmarkThreshold.description: Minimum number of uses in the atlas for a constant to be drawn as a landmark.
